name: aegis
description: A user-controlled trust and permission layer for AI agents on Monad.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aegis/sdk && npm run build --workspace @aegis/agent-demo && npm run build --workspace @aegis/web
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @aegis/sdk && npm run dev --workspace @aegis/web
scripts.demo:web: npm run build --workspace @aegis/sdk && npm run dev:web --workspace @aegis/agent-demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @aegis/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @aegis/sdk && npm run build --workspace @aegis/agent-demo && node --test packages/sdk/test/*.test.mjs
